title: Field Guide: Pinyin Typing & Syllable Mechanics

words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 在手机上切换到拼音输入法。(Zài shǒujī shang qiēhuàn dào pīnyīn shūrùfǎ.) — Switch to the Pinyin input method on your phone.
从候选词列表里挑选正确的汉字。(Cóng hòuxuǎncí lièbiǎo lǐ tiāoxuǎn zhèngquè de hànzì.) — Pick the correct Chinese character from the candidate list.
按加号键或者等号键翻页选字。(Àn jiāhào jiàn huòzhě děnghào jiàn fānyè xuǎnzì.) — Press plus or equals key to page through candidate characters.
中文标点符号占一个完整的汉字空格。(Zhōngwén biāodiǎn fúhào zhàn yí ge wánzhěng de hànzì kònggé.) — Chinese punctuation marks take up a full character width.
在句子短暂停顿处输入中文逗号。(Zài jùzi duǎnzàn tíngdùn chù shūrù zhōngwén dòuhào.) — Enter a Chinese comma at brief pauses in a sentence.
每句话写完整后记得打上句号。(Měi jù huà xiě wánzhěng hòu jìde dǎ shang jùhào.) — Remember to put a period after completing each sentence.
疑问句结尾要使用中文问号。(Yíwènjù jiéwěi yào shǐyòng zhōngwén wènhào.) — Use a Chinese question mark at the end of interrogative sentences.
感叹情绪强烈的句子用叹号结尾。(Gǎntàn qíngxù qiángliè de jùzi yòng tànhào jiéwěi.) — Use exclamation marks at the end of strong emotive sentences.
按空格键直接确认第一个候选词。(Àn kònggéjiàn zhíjiē quèrèn dì yī ge hòuxuǎncí.) — Press the spacebar to confirm the first candidate word directly.
按回车键可以直接输出英文字母。(Àn huíchējiàn kěyǐ zhíjiē shūchū yīngwén zìmǔ.) — Press enter key to output English letters directly.
拼音由英文字母组成。(Pīnyīn yóu yīngwén zìmǔ zǔchéng.) — Pinyin is composed of English letters.
普通话拼音一共有二十一个声母。(Pǔtōnghuà pīnyīn yígòng yǒu èrshíyī ge shēngmǔ.) — Standard Mandarin pinyin has 21 initials in total.
练习好单韵母和复韵母的发音。(Liànxí hǎo dān yùnmǔ hé fù yùnmǔ de fāyīn.) — Practice pronunciation of simple and compound finals well.
采用整词输入可以大大提高打字准确率。(Cǎiyòng zhěngcí shūrù kěyǐ dàdà tígāo dǎzì zhǔnquèlǜ.) — Typing whole words greatly improves character recognition accuracy.
输入西安时在两个音节中间加上隔音符号。(Shūrù Xī'ān shí zài liǎng ge yīnjié zhōngjiān jiā shang géyīn fúhào.) — Add an apostrophe delimiter between syllables when typing Xi'an.
发信息前多检查一遍避免错别字。(Fā xìnxī qián duō jiǎnchá yí biàn bìmiǎn cuòbiézì.) — Proofread before sending messages to avoid typos.
初学打字不要只打单字。(Chūxué dǎzì bú yào zhǐ dǎ dānzì.) — Beginners should avoid typing single characters only.
输入法会自动提供常用的联想词。(Shūrùfǎ huì zìdòng tígōng chángyòng de liánxiǎngcí.) — The input method automatically offers common predictive phrases.
手忙的时候可以用语音输入发消息。(Shǒu máng de shíhou kěyǐ yòng yǔyīn shūrù fā xiāoxi.) — When hands are busy you can use voice input to send messages.
输入每个字的声母简拼即可出词。(Shūrù měi ge zì de shēngmǔ jiǎnpīn jíkě chū cí.) — Typing just the initials of each word will suggest the phrase.
